public_rationale: Under the ordinary reading, the claim holds. Anthropic documented deployed models helping an actor develop successful exploits and steal sensitive personal information. The described mechanism requires software assistance and human misuse, without requiring consciousness or hypothetical advanced general intelligence. This supports the possibility of substantial danger, not a claim that every LLM is dangerous in every setting.
limitations: Support depends on reading powerful AI in the surrounding discussion's sense of hypothetical advanced intelligence.
The evidence does not prove that any particular model lacks consciousness.
The decisive incident account comes from the model provider.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs can be incredibly dangerous without being conscious or powerful AI.
conditions: without being conscious or powerful AI

statement.excerpt: LLMs do not have to be conscious or powerful AI to be incredibly dangerous.
statement.document_title: AI Is Already In Dangerous Hands

from_speaker: do not have to be conscious
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that deployed LLMs can enable serious harm without consciousness or the hypothetical advanced general intelligence discussed in the surrounding passage.
Serious unauthorized access, theft of sensitive personal information and operational assistance to harmful campaigns qualify as substantial danger.
Powerful AI cannot reasonably mean any software capable of harm; that reading would make the statement circular.
For this ongoing capability claim, use December 2025 through August 2026, the latest completed misuse-reporting window publicly reported before the post.
The assessment concerns whether the documented mechanism of harm requires consciousness. It does not claim that consciousness has been experimentally disproved.
criteria.support_condition: Documented incidents show deployed LLMs materially enabling serious harm through ordinary software capabilities, without requiring consciousness or hypothetical advanced general intelligence.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that the purported examples did not involve serious danger or that the harm depended on the advanced properties said to be unnecessary.
